newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese fishermen rescue 31 sailors after storm.
newsitem.headline: Chinese fishermen rescue 31 sailors after storm.

text.p: Fishermen in southern China rescued 31 Chinese naval sailors who were swept off their vessel during a typhoon, the Nanfang Daily said in an edition seen in Beijing on Tuesday.

The People's Liberation Army sailors had been knocked into the ocean when their landing craft was battered by Typhoon Willie, which slammed into southern China last week, the newspaper said in its Sunday edition.

The 31 sailors had drifted in waters separating the southern provinces of Guangdong and Hainan island for 18 hours before being picked up the local fishermen, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
